visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up on a modern elevator display panel. A glowing yellow-orange arrow points downwards next to a digit '7' which changes as the lift descends. A hand with a watch enters the frame to point specifically at the number '1' on the directory. The surrounding wall is light grey with subtle textures. Subtitles and slogans appear at the top and bottom. (2) Close-up of a hand quickly and repeatedly pressing the elevator's 'Open' and floor buttons. The panel is brushed metal with round black buttons. The urgency is visible through the rapid finger movements and the slight shakiness of the camera, capturing the tactile interaction with the elevator interface. (3) The camera pans to reveal a man in his late 20s or 30s inside the elevator. He wears a grey striped sweatshirt and olive green cargo pants, holding a compact gimbal camera. His expression is one of extreme distress and physical discomfort; he holds his head and shifts his weight anxiously. The lift interior is grey carpeted. (4) A first-person perspective (POV) shot shows rapid movement through a residential hallway. The floor has a grey-patterned carpet, and the walls are a neutral beige. The camera shakes significantly, mimicking a running gait. Doors and hallway lights pass by quickly as the protagonist rushes toward his destination. (5) Close-up of a digital door lock on a dark wood door. A hand reaches out to touch the sensor, causing it to glow with blue and green lights. The screen shows numeric input. The camera captures the frantic nature of the attempt to unlock the door, focusing on the mechanical and electronic interaction. (6) The door opens, and the POV camera moves swiftly through a modern apartment interior. It passes a small kitchen area with a countertop and enters a brightly lit room with a blue sofa and balcony. The movement ends abruptly as the camera focuses on a dark surface in what appears to be a bathroom. (7) The screen transitions to a solid black background. Large white Traditional Chinese characters '解脫' appear in the center. The visual focus is entirely on this text, representing a conclusion to the previous frantic sequence. The visual simplicity contrasts with the earlier high-motion scenes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the heavy, rhythmic thudding of rapid footsteps on a hard surface, accompanied by high-arousal, quick-paced breathing. A male voice speaks with an agitated and urgent tone, his pitch rising as he expresses discomfort. There is no background music, emphasizing the raw, physical sound of his distress. (2) A rhythmic, percussive sound of feet hitting the ground continues. The vocal delivery shifts into a repetitive chant of 'Memorize the password,' spoken with a fast speech rate and sharp articulation. The background ambient noise is a low-frequency hum typical of an indoor building environment. No BGM is present. (3) A high-pitched, digital 'ding' sounds, followed by the mechanical sliding noise of an elevator door opening. This transient event marks a change in the acoustic environment to a more enclosed space. The man's breathing remains heavy and strained, indicating continued high physical arousal and tension. (4) Inside the elevator, the male voice speaks in a self-reflective, worried tone with moderate pitch variability. His breathing is loud and close to the microphone, creating a sense of intimacy and urgency. The elevator's mechanical movement creates a subtle, steady low-frequency background drone. (5) Another sharp digital 'ding' occurs, signaling the arrival at the floor. This is followed by the sound of the doors sliding open once more. The footsteps resume immediately, transitioning from a mechanical hum to a more resonant, shuffling sound as the man steps out onto a carpeted hallway. (6) Rapid, muffled thuds of running on carpet dominate the track. The breathing becomes more erratic and strained, with audible gasps. The vocal arousal level is extremely high, with the speaker making short, distressed exclamations. The acoustic texture is focused on the immediate vicinity of the runner. (7) A series of high-pitched electronic beeps and mechanical clicks are heard as the digital door lock is engaged. These sharp, transient sounds indicate the frantic attempt to enter the home. The sound of a door latch clicking open provides a clear acoustic resolution to the lock sequence. (8) The door creaks open, followed by a sudden burst of fast footsteps on a hard floor. There is the rustling of fabric and a final, dull thud as an object is moved or placed down. The breathing reaches a peak intensity before a moment of sudden vocal silence. (9) A loud, continuous broadband noise of rushing water begins, filling the entire spectral range. This sound provides a strong acoustic resolution to the previous tension. The previous sounds of footsteps and heavy breathing cease entirely, replaced by this singular, powerful environmental sound.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously depict the extreme physical and psychological urgency of needing to use the bathroom after drinking too much, utilizing fast-paced POV editing and raw audio to create a sense of frantic tension that resolves in a punchline.
